title: [IRS Forms] Performance optimization
summary: IRS 1099 form box calculation now queries detailed vendor ledger entries with a current key matching its equality filters and can filter payments by vendor. Profiling had shown one query taking most of a roughly 10-minute run; calculation results are unchanged.
key_points: FindRelatedApplicationDetailedVendorLedgerEntries now uses the existing key Application No., Vendor No., Entry Type instead of Vendor Ledger Entry No., Entry Type
FilterPaymentVendorLedgerEntries gets a VendorNo parameter and filters on Vendor No. when a specific vendor is requested
No schema changes; existing keys are reused
Single-vendor recalculations no longer enumerate payments for the whole period
Performance gain still to be confirmed by re-profiling; existing tests cover the paths
quote: Aligning the current key with those equality filters lets the optimizer satisfy the ordering with a selective index seek instead of a broad scan.
